title: TANGO: Clustering with Typicality-Aware Nonlocal Mode-Seeking and Graph-Cut Optimization
reviewed_version: Published ICML 2025 PMLR267 19-page PDF; source commit 8ce4d380293b29853f4e4cbb13679e8e1f6722aa
summary: Incorrect Nemenyi threshold changes three pairwise conclusions; omitted normalization breaks printed graph-contraction equivalence; q-squared output cost omitted; power-law constant contradicts scaling and stochastic application assumptions unestablished.
limitations: No author-code execution or benchmark reproduction.
Nemenyi calculation holds printed rank gaps fixed; raw ranks, missing-result handling, and Friedman statistic not regenerated.
No complete replacement tail theorem verified; external cited tail theorem not retrieved.
Image-segmentation panels and all figure values not audited.
No comprehensive later-version or erratum search.

problems.source_claim: All TANGO pairwise differences exceed Nemenyi CD=2.30 using q=.05 critical1.96.
assumptions: Standard asymptotic all-pairs Nemenyi test explicitly named in paper
problems.check: Range95=4.551863584; q=range/sqrt2=3.218653607; CD=3.774205901. LDP-SC3.66,QKSPP3.19,USPEC3.38 do not pass.
problems.result: Claim of significance against every competitor fails under the named test.
problems.counterevidence: Average performance and other significant comparisons can remain; omnibus Friedman rejection is not every-pair significance.
problems.core_dependency: Direct evidence for central empirical superiority claim.
problems.impact: Major; no claim algorithm inferior or scores fabricated.

correction.statement: Use correct all-pairs quantile and revise pairwise conclusions.

problems.source_claim: Definition5 sets internal capacities1 and claims contraction computes widest paths using unnormalized Definition1 similarities.
assumptions: k7, self excluded, one-based ranks; all paper pipeline stages independently evaluated
problems.check: Definition5 PBSim(5,17)=1; contraction=1.4163329639588824. Raw maxA=5.4874387419. Normalizing A removes mismatch on both examples.
problems.result: Printed equivalence fails; released normalization repairs the identified mechanism.
problems.counterevidence: TANGO.py72 explicitly normalizes A; no defect in normalized release path computation demonstrated.
problems.core_dependency: Path similarity and its efficient computation are core algorithm components.
problems.impact: Major formal-definition/correctness issue; historical benchmark impact unverified.

correction.statement: State A/maxA normalization so internal capacity1 dominates all inter-group edges.
correction.limits: Full historical source and self-loop conventions still require binding.

problems.source_claim: Theorem3 O(nk log(nk)); proof drops q² because q<<n; overall complexity then O(nk²d).
assumptions: Explicit dense path-similarity output as Algorithm3 and release
No quantitative bound on q in theorem
problems.check: Every unordered pair written once, q(q-1)/2. Equal-density regular polygon k4 has no leaders,q=n,connected similarity graph. Even q=o(n) does not imply q²=O(n log n).
problems.result: q² output term cannot be removed; spectral q³ needs separate domination condition.
problems.counterevidence: Small-q empirical times may remain correct; compressed query representation is different from dense interface.
problems.core_dependency: Efficiency of core aggregation is an advertised theorem.
problems.impact: Major computational guarantee; no claim recorded times false.

correction.statement: Retain O(nk log(nk)+q²), plus spectral and neighbor-search costs.
correction.limits: No universal KD-tree bound or alternative compressed implementation certified.

problems.source_claim: Theorem4 predicts CN=(EB)^alpha/(1-EN E(B^alpha)) and claims finite typicality obeys power law.
assumptions: Abstract independent smoothing model as stated
Mixed Poisson offspring: Pareto mixing shape2,min.25, mean offspring.5
Both subcritical weighted branching solutions finite mean
problems.check: T_.5=.5T_1 pathwise; same N law requires tail constant ratio1/4, while printed CN predicts identical positive0.145157767 for both.
problems.result: Universal stated constant cannot hold; finite triangular uniqueness and hierarchy do not establish stochastic independence or regular variation.
problems.counterevidence: Suitable additional random-tree assumptions may permit power law; clustering computation does not use this asymptotic theorem.
problems.core_dependency: Advertised statistical characterization of the proposed typicality measure.
problems.impact: Major theoretical-property claim; not a benchmark tail fit or performance refutation.

correction.statement: Specify generative limit, independence and normalization; supply valid tail theorem.
correction.limits: No claim original cited external theorem is wrong.
